title: Marker-Based Augmented Reality Poster for a Science Fair
description: Overlays 3D models and short explanations on printed posters when viewed through a phone, and tests how lighting, distance and print quality affect how reliably the marker is recognised.

title: Virtual Museum Room in the Browser with WebXR
description: Builds a walk-through gallery with objects that can be inspected closely, runs in a headset or a normal browser and measures frame rate on different devices. Includes a fallback mode for visitors without a headset.

title: Anatomy Explorer in Augmented Reality with Quiz Mode
description: Lets students peel back layers of a 3D body model on a table, answers label questions and tracks which structures they confuse most, with models checked for accuracy by a tutor.

title: Photogrammetry Pipeline for Scanning Small Objects
description: Turns phone photos of a small object into a textured 3D model, compares capture strategies for model quality and prepares the result for real-time viewing at a low polygon count.

title: Shared Mixed-Reality Whiteboard for Remote Classrooms
description: Lets two people see and edit the same virtual drawings in their own rooms, synchronises positions through a shared anchor and measures delay under different network conditions.

title: Low-Vision Reading Aid with Adjustable Text Overlay
description: Magnifies and re-colours printed text seen through the camera with adjustable contrast and spacing, tested with volunteers who report which settings help them read faster.

title: Virtual Chemistry Lab with Safe Reaction Rules
description: Lets students mix virtual reagents and see rule-based outcomes with warnings about real hazards, built with a small, checked rule set and tested by a teacher for accuracy.
